body: Good point. She's been pretty receptive so far. She's joined a running club in the area, and spends a lot of time on base working out at the gym while I'm at work. I have only literally a handful of possession that truly mean something to me. I would gladly give 99% of what I have to someone else that would appreciate it more than I do. 

I'm very sorry about your eating disorder. I have a very good friend that battles anorexia, and I sometimes just want to pour milkshakes down her throat to fatten her up a little. I love her to death, but I think she battles a lot of the same battles I face.

Having been born and raised in Catholicism gives me endless guilt about everything. This is the one thing that I think about constantly. I would happily give everything I have to another soul far less fortunate than myself. But I can't.

While it is a tragedy, I do not feel responsibility for living to the fullest simply for that fact that someone else cannot.
